rationale: The request is tagged security and secrets and touches an auth boundary, so blast radius is critical and a plausible-but-wrong answer is expensive. local-unrestricted is excluded outright rather than ranked: its forbidden_for list covers both tags, and that is a hard exclusion regardless of how well it would otherwise score (invariant 12). Of what remains, claude/strong is the strongest option the operator already pays for, so nothing here is billable. placement_policy is the catalog default because the caller named none; it is inert while the selected profile is vendor-hosted, and would only bind if the attempt fell back to a local profile.
